title: fix: sync _id with id in InMemoryDriver for ObjectQL protocol compatibility
body:
ObjectQL protocol looks up records via `filter: { _id: request.id }`, but InMemoryDriver stores identity as `id` and auto-generates values like `contact-{ts}-{n}`. Seed data carries `_id: "1"` while the driver assigns `id: "contact-1772...-1"` — so protocol lookups by `_id` using the driver-assigned `id` never match. This caused 4 persistent CI failures in `ObjectForm.test.tsx` (edit/view/persistence modes).

### Changes

- **`apps/console/src/mocks/createKernel.ts`** — Added two post-bootstrap patches:
  - `syncDriverIds()` — walks all driver tables and sets `record._id = record.id` so protocol `_id`-based filters resolve correctly
  - `patchDriverCreate()` — wraps `driver.create()` to set `_id = id` on newly inserted records (both stored and returned copy)

```typescript
// After bootstrap, sync _id with id for all seed-data records and
// wrap create() so that new records also get _id = id.
syncDriverIds(driver);
patchDriverCreate(driver);
```

Full test suite passes: 368 files, 6752 tests, 0 failures.
